title: SculkSpeak
description: Your mic now sets off sculk sensors.
body:
**SculkSpeak** brings real voice vibrations into Minecraft.

Using _your_ microphone, this mod lets nearby sculk sensors react to actual sounds you make in real life. Talk, clap, whisper, scream, play music, or make noise- the Deep Dark will hear you.

**Features:**

🎤 Real-life microphone input detection
🔵 Sculk sensors activate from your voice, so be quiet
📢 Adjustable sensitivity settings
🧠 Works in survival, horror maps, and multiplayer
👂 Makes Wardens even more terrifying, just kidding!

Whether you're sneaking through the Deep Dark or trolling your friends by screaming into your mic, SculkSpeak turns your room into part of the game.

**Be quiet. The sculk is listening.**
